notes: The groups that have files, in order. sort says what they are: received (the default) groups by the day files arrived, taken by the day they were taken (files without a known date taken count on the day they arrived), sender by who sent them, keyed by their id, or "pin" for files that came with a PIN. order is newest (the default) or oldest: days newest or oldest first; senders by their newest file, or with oldest by their oldest. key is the day (YYYY-MM-DD) or the sender's id or "pin"; last_day is the day its newest file arrived; from is a sender's name, null for days, PIN guests and someone no longer here. version grows with every change to the library (new files, thumbnails, deletions): poll this and reload when it changes. folder narrows it to one folder (404 not_found for a folder the caller doesn't see); without it, every folder the caller sees: admins every folder, members the ones they were given. kind is photo, video or document; q matches part of the file name. 400 bad_request for another sort or order, and for sort=sender from a PIN session. PIN sessions get 403 forbidden on every library endpoint, unless their PIN shows its folder (shows_folder): then they see that folder, as a member given only it would, except that from is always null.
